title: Maximal localization of a finite principal-open extension
statement: Let $S,T$ be integral domains, $m$ a maximal ideal of $S$, $s\in S\setminus m$, and $g:S_s\to T$ an injective finite ring map [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Set $h=g\circ(S\to S_s)$ and $M=h(S\setminus m)$. Then $M^{-1}T$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] admits an injective finite $S_m$-algebra structure [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Every maximal ideal $q$ of $M^{-1}T$ contracts to a maximal ideal $n_0$ of $T$, and $mT\subseteq n_0$, where $mT$ means extension along $h$.

source.place: Tag 0334, proposition-nagata-universally-japanese, Step 5: residue-polynomial lifting, finite splitting extension, integral closure and roots over maximal ideals

proof.text: Define the canonical localization map using the image of the complement of m. Injectivity of h follows from injectivity of principal localization in a domain. Injectivity descends to localization. The powers of s lie in the complement of m, so S_m is the localization of S_s at the image of that complement. The image of that monoid in T is M. Apply Module.Finite.of_isLocalization to the finite S_s-module T.

Finiteness makes the localized map integral. A maximal ideal q contracts to the unique maximal ideal of S_m by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-is-integral] and [lem-weil-pbc-integral-maximal-contracts-maximal]. Composing contraction with S -> S_m gives m, by the localization maximal ideal identity. The same composite through T gives that the contraction n0 to T contains the extension mT.

Contract n0 along g to an ideal J of S_s. Its contraction to S is m by the previous composite identity. Since S_s is a localization and m is maximal, J is maximal (Ideal.IsMaximal.of_isLocalization_of_disjoint). The prime ideal n0 lies over J in the integral extension g, so [lem-weil-pbc-integral-prime-over-maximal-maximal] proves n0 maximal.

theorem exists_finite_away_maximal_localization
    (S : Type u) (T : Type v) [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [CommRing T] [IsDomain T]
    (m : Ideal S) [m.IsMaximal] (s : S) (hs : s ∉ m)
    (g : Localization.Away s →+* T) (hg : Function.Injective g) (hfin : g.Finite) :
    let h := g.comp (algebraMap S (Localization.Away s))
    let M := m.primeCompl.map h
    ∃ (_ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime m) (Localization M)),
      Function.Injective (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime m) (Localization M)) ∧
      Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime m) (Localization M) ∧
      ∀ (q : Ideal (Localization M)) [q.IsMaximal],
        (q.comap (algebraMap T (Localization M))).IsMaximal ∧
        m.map h ≤ q.comap (algebraMap T (Localization M))
